intro.zh: 换一个模型，保留经验驱动的执行闭环。
intro.en: Change the model while keeping the experience-guided execution loop.

start.zh: 兼容 Chat Completions 的服务可配置 base_url、model 与 api_key_env；原生协议可通过 llm.factory 实现 ChatProvider.complete。先验证结构化 Plan，再运行独立验收。
start.en: Configure base_url, model and api_key_env for compatible Chat Completions services. Use llm.factory and ChatProvider.complete for native protocols. Validate a structured Plan before running the independent checks.

title.zh: 官方 API · 先连接服务

description.zh: 文本、推理与工具接口；从官方 API 文档开始。
description.en: Text, reasoning and tool interfaces; start with the API documentation.

description.zh: 多模态与文本生成，查看 Gemini API 接入方式。
description.en: Text and multimodal generation through the Gemini API.

description.zh: Messages API、工具调用与上下文组织。
description.en: Messages API, tool use and context construction.

description.zh: 本项目使用的 API 路线，可从现有配置开始替换。
description.en: The API route used in this project; start with the existing provider.

description.zh: 托管 Qwen 等模型，学习兼容接口与模型配置。
description.en: Hosted Qwen models, compatible endpoints and model configuration.

description.zh: 查看模型调用、上下文与输出协议。
description.en: Model calls, context handling and response formats.

description.zh: 模型 API、工具调用及结构化任务接入。
description.en: Model APIs, tool use and structured task integration.

description.zh: 文本模型 API 与推理服务的接入说明。
description.en: Text model APIs and inference service integration.

items.name: 字节跳动 · 火山方舟

description.zh: 托管模型服务与应用 API 接入。
description.en: Hosted model services and application API integration.

description.zh: 文本、代码模型与工具调用接口。
description.en: Text and code models with tool interfaces.

description.zh: 生成、Embedding 与 Rerank 服务。
description.en: Generation, embedding and reranking services.

description.zh: 托管推理服务，学习兼容客户端接入。
description.en: Hosted inference with compatible client integration.

description.zh: 开放模型的托管推理与 API 服务。
description.en: Hosted inference and APIs for open models.

description.zh: 模型推理、部署与 API 调用。
description.en: Model inference, deployment and API calls.

description.zh: 多种开放模型的托管 API 服务。
description.en: Hosted APIs for multiple open model families.

description.zh: 统一 API 网关，探索多提供商模型路由。
description.en: A unified API gateway for routing across model providers.

title.zh: 开放权重模型 · 选择本地模型
title.en: Open-weight models · choose a local model

description.zh: Qwen 系列：从官方推理与部署说明开始。
description.en: Qwen models with official inference and deployment guides.

description.zh: 从官方模型仓库选择权重与推理示例。
description.en: Choose weights and inference examples from official repositories.

description.zh: Meta 模型系列与官方模型使用说明。
description.en: Meta model families and official usage documentation.

description.zh: Google 开放权重模型与部署资料。
description.en: Google open-weight models and deployment resources.

description.zh: 官方推理代码与模型使用示例。
description.en: Official inference code and model usage examples.

description.zh: 微软小型语言模型与模型集合。
description.en: Microsoft small language models and model collections.

description.zh: 中文模型、推理与应用实践资料。
description.en: Chinese language models, inference and application examples.

description.zh: 开放模型、训练与推理研究代码。
description.en: Open models with training and inference research code.

title.zh: 部署工具 · 再启动推理服务
title.en: Serving tools · run an inference endpoint

description.zh: 先在自己的电脑启动模型服务，再接入项目。
description.en: Run a local model service first, then connect it to this project.

description.zh: 学习高吞吐推理与 OpenAI-compatible 服务。
description.en: High-throughput inference and OpenAI-compatible serving.

description.zh: 学习模型服务、调度与兼容 API 部署。
description.en: Model serving, scheduling and compatible API deployment.

description.zh: 学习量化模型与本地 CPU / GPU 推理。
description.en: Quantized models and local CPU or GPU inference.

intro.zh: 让任务、证据与输出要求更清楚。
intro.en: Make tasks, evidence and output requirements explicit.

start.zh: 从 prompt_builder.py 开始，比较不同的任务说明、Few-shot 与 JSON 输出约定；使用同一组任务做回归对照。
start.en: Start in prompt_builder.py. Compare instructions, few-shot examples and JSON contracts against the same regression tasks.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 学习、管理与评测
title.en: Selected starting points · learn, manage and evaluate

description.zh: Few-shot、ReAct 与提示词设计基础。
description.en: Few-shot prompting, ReAct and prompt design foundations.

description.zh: 任务指令、上下文组织与输出要求。
description.en: Instructions, context construction and output requirements.

description.zh: 管理 Prompt 模板、版本与运行追踪。
description.en: Manage prompt templates, versions and runtime traces.

description.zh: 为 Prompt 建立对照测试与回归检查。
description.en: Build comparison tests and regression checks for prompts.

intro.zh: 替换检索组件，让经验更容易被找到。
intro.en: Swap retrieval components to make experience easier to find.

start.zh: 先保留 RetrievalResult 的来源与评分字段，再替换 Embedding、索引或 Retriever。用现有消融查询比较效果。
start.en: Preserve RetrievalResult provenance and scores, then replace embeddings, the index or the retriever. Compare results with the existing ablation queries.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 流水线、编码与图检索
title.en: Selected starting points · pipelines, encoding and graph retrieval

description.zh: 学习数据接入、Chunk、索引与检索流水线。
description.en: Data connectors, chunks, indexes and retrieval pipelines.

description.zh: 将文档处理、检索与生成组织成组件。
description.en: Compose document processing, retrieval and generation components.

description.zh: 探索 BGE 编码器和 Reranker，先做单组件替换。
description.en: Explore BGE encoders and rerankers, replacing one component at a time.

description.zh: 了解图结构与向量检索结合，再适配来源字段。
description.en: Explore graph and vector retrieval, then adapt provenance fields.

intro.zh: 从自由文本走向可校验的计划。
intro.en: Move from free text to validated plans.

start.zh: 保持 Plan / Actions 输出契约，尝试任务拆解、分步规划或更多工具；让同一个 Validator 判断结果。
start.en: Keep the Plan / Actions contract. Try decomposition, stepwise planning or more tools, using the same validator to judge outcomes.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 规划与结构化动作
title.en: Selected starting points · planning and structured actions

description.zh: 把规划、执行与重试写成显式状态转换。
description.en: Express planning, execution and retries as state transitions.

description.zh: 用较少代码理解模型如何选择并调用工具。
description.en: Understand model-driven tool selection with a small code surface.

description.zh: 用类型约束组织模型输出、工具与计划。
description.en: Typed model outputs, tools and plans.

description.zh: 观察软件工程任务中的计划、动作和反馈。
description.en: Study plans, actions and feedback in software engineering tasks.

intro.zh: 让一次运行的经验可以再次被利用。
intro.en: Make experience from one run reusable in later tasks.

start.zh: 先尝试把成功运行人工审核后写回 EngineeringCase；再探索跨轮次状态和长期记忆，保留来源与版本。
start.en: Start with reviewed successful runs written back as EngineeringCase records. Then explore cross-turn state and long-term memory with provenance and versions.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 状态与长期经验
title.en: Selected starting points · state and long-term experience

description.zh: 学习检查点、会话状态与中断恢复。
description.en: Checkpoints, conversation state and resumable execution.

description.zh: 探索记忆抽取、保存和按任务取回。
description.en: Memory extraction, storage and task-based recall.

description.zh: 学习长期交互中的记忆与上下文管理。
description.en: Memory and context management in persistent interactions.

description.zh: 探索带时间与实体关系的经验组织方式。
description.en: Organize experience with temporal and entity relationships.

intro.zh: 从一个文件动作，扩展到受控工具集。
intro.en: Extend a file action into a controlled toolset.

start.zh: 在动作 Schema、白名单和整批校验之外增加工具适配器；工具返回结构化观察，让失败仍可进入下一轮。
start.en: Add tool adapters while retaining action schemas, allowlists and whole-batch validation. Return structured observations so failures can inform the next attempt.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 工具协议与适配
title.en: Selected starting points · tool protocols and adapters

description.zh: 用标准协议封装文件、检索或业务工具。
description.en: Expose file, retrieval or business tools through a standard protocol.

description.zh: 从小型工具函数理解参数、执行和返回值。
description.en: Learn tool arguments, execution and return values through small functions.

description.zh: 学习工具 Schema、上下文与集成方式。
description.en: Tool schemas, context and integration patterns.

description.zh: 用类型约束工具参数与结构化结果。
description.en: Typed tool arguments and structured results.

intro.zh: 把计划真正落到隔离的工程副本。
intro.en: Apply plans to an isolated project copy.

start.zh: 实现 ProjectAdapter：检查点、动作执行、验证与恢复。先接文件或 Git 工作区，再考虑容器执行。
start.en: Implement ProjectAdapter checkpoints, actions, validation and recovery. Start with files or a Git workspace before adding container execution.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 代码编辑与运行环境
title.en: Selected starting points · code edits and runtime environments

description.zh: 学习 Git 工作区、代码编辑与变更审阅。
description.en: Git workspaces, code edits and change review.

description.zh: 参考代码任务中的工作区与执行工具。
description.en: Workspace and execution tools for coding tasks.

description.zh: 从 Python 启停容器并收集运行结果。
description.en: Control containers from Python and collect execution results.

description.zh: 探索通过 SDK 调用隔离的代码运行环境。
description.en: Use an SDK to run code in isolated environments.

intro.zh: 让每个动作都有可追溯的结果。
intro.en: Make every action produce traceable evidence.

start.zh: 在 RunTrace 的阶段事件和 stdout / stderr 之上增加调用链追踪；把同一轮的检索、模型和测试串起来。
start.en: Extend RunTrace events and stdout / stderr with traces connecting retrieval, model calls and tests within each attempt.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 追踪与可观测性
title.en: Selected starting points · tracing and observability

description.zh: 观察模型调用、Prompt、耗时与运行链。
description.en: Trace model calls, prompts, latency and execution chains.

description.zh: 探索 LLM 调用链和检索结果分析。
description.en: Analyze LLM traces and retrieval results.

description.zh: 用 Span 与 Trace 关联跨模块执行。
description.en: Connect execution across modules using spans and traces.

description.zh: 查看 Agent 运行轨迹与评测记录。
description.en: Inspect agent runs, traces and evaluation records.

intro.zh: 用失败证据，改变下一次尝试。
intro.en: Use failure evidence to change the next attempt.

start.zh: 从 workflow.py 的失败上下文开始，提取原因、形成下一轮约束，并比较是否减少相同错误；不要仅重复生成。
start.en: Start with failure context in workflow.py. Extract causes and next-attempt constraints, then measure repeated errors.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 反馈与改进
title.en: Selected starting points · feedback and improvement

description.zh: 理解语言反馈如何参与后续任务尝试。
description.en: Study how language feedback informs subsequent task attempts.

description.zh: 把检查、错误分析和重试显式串联。
description.en: Connect checks, error analysis and retries explicitly.

description.zh: 探索基于指标优化提示与程序；区别于运行时反思。
description.en: Metric-driven prompt and program optimization, distinct from runtime reflection.

description.zh: 参考编程 Agent 如何获取执行反馈并继续修改。
description.en: Study how coding agents collect execution feedback and continue editing.

intro.zh: 显式管理状态、分支与终止条件。
intro.en: Manage state, branches and termination explicitly.

start.zh: 先保留 run_agent() 的 PASS / Retry / Rollback 语义，再尝试状态图、任务调度与持久化。
start.en: Preserve the PASS / Retry / Rollback semantics of run_agent() before adding state graphs, scheduling or persistence.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 编排与状态
title.en: Selected starting points · orchestration and state

description.zh: 显式控制节点、条件分支和恢复状态。
description.en: Control nodes, conditional branches and resumable state.

description.zh: 从类型化 Agent 和工作流开始。
description.en: Start with typed agents and workflows.

description.zh: 了解多个角色之间的消息与任务协调。
description.en: Explore messaging and task coordination across agent roles.

description.zh: 学习重试、任务状态与运行调度。
description.en: Task retries, execution states and workflow scheduling.

intro.zh: 用固定任务与指标判断改进是否有效。
intro.en: Judge improvements with fixed tasks and metrics.

start.zh: 扩充独立业务任务，固定验收阈值，再比较检索指标和代码任务成功率；两者分别统计。
start.en: Add independent business tasks and fix acceptance thresholds. Measure retrieval quality and coding-task success separately.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 检索与任务评测
title.en: Selected starting points · retrieval and task evaluation

description.zh: 探索检索、忠实度与回答相关性指标。
description.en: Retrieval, faithfulness and answer relevance metrics.

description.zh: 为 RAG 与 Agent 建立自动化质量检查。
description.en: Automated quality checks for RAG and agents.

description.zh: 同一批任务比较模型、Prompt 与回归结果。
description.en: Compare models, prompts and regressions on the same tasks.

description.zh: 先把接口、运行与回退要求写成可执行测试。
description.en: Turn interface, runtime and fallback requirements into executable tests.

intro.zh: 在动作发生前，明确可执行的边界。
intro.en: Define enforceable boundaries before actions execute.

start.zh: 保留文件白名单和固定验证命令，扩展参数校验、权限与隔离。当前项目尚无操作系统级沙箱。
start.en: Keep file allowlists and fixed validation commands while extending argument validation, permissions and isolation. This project has no OS-level sandbox today.

title.zh: 精选起点 · 校验与执行边界
title.en: Selected starting points · validation and execution boundaries

description.zh: 先为任务、Plan 和工具参数建立 Schema。
description.en: Define schemas for tasks, plans and tool arguments.

description.zh: 探索结构化输出验证与规则检查。
description.en: Structured output validation and rule-based checks.

description.zh: 了解可配置的交互与工具调用约束。
description.en: Configurable conversation and tool-use constraints.

description.zh: 探索容器隔离；仍需配置权限、挂载和网络边界。
description.en: Explore container isolation with explicit permissions, mounts and network boundaries.
